prompt: We want to build a reporting dashboard that pulls data from Orders, Inventory, and Customers to show business KPIs. Where should it live?
assertions: Shows evidence of reading the existing context files (references Orders, Inventory, and/or Customers)
Raises the question of ownership or boundaries for a feature that reads across multiple existing contexts
Uses the Q:/Recommendation format with a concrete recommendation
Treats reporting as likely a separate context rather than silently embedding it in one of the three
Uses plain business language with NO DDD jargon in the user-facing text
Keeps implementation details (ETL/event-store/query mechanics) out — stays at the ownership/boundary level
